steps: Tiny DDPM on Fashion-MNIST (1,000 samples per point; FD in the classifier's feature space, where 1,000 real images score 18.9): DDPM at 1 / 4 / 10 / 50 / 250 / 1,000 steps FD 1,493.9 / 300.3 / 130.5 / 62.3 / 39.7 / 34.9; DDIM at 1 / 4 / 10 / 50 / 250 steps 1,493.9 / 478.9 / 181.3 / 112.7 / 108.2; DPM-Solver++ reaches 101.2 at 20 steps. On this briefly trained model the stochastic DDPM sampler beats DDIM from 4 steps up, the opposite of the DDIM paper's well-trained CIFAR-10 result. One network evaluation takes 6.0 ms for one image and 332 ms for 1,000 measured on Apple M1 Pro (MPS). On Stable Diffusion v1.5 with DPM-Solver++ and guidance 7.5, 1 to 4 steps give a blur, 10 a usable image, 25 and 50 nearly the same image, at 0.610 s per guided step measured; DDIM with SD 1.5's default 'leading' spacing starts its single step at t = 1 and returns noise.
cfg: Stable Diffusion v1.5, "a photograph of a lighthouse on a cliff at sunset", seed 0, 25 steps: the empty prompt draws an unrelated scene, s = 1 a coast with no clear lighthouse, s = 2 and above the lighthouse, past 10 a deep orange sky and harsh contrast (mean colour saturation 0.35 at s = 1, 0.47 at 7.5, 0.61 at 20) measured. On the tiny class-conditional model, class accuracy goes from 77.8% at s = 1 to 96.4% at s = 5, FD is best at s = 2 (35.5) and diversity falls from 28.38 to 20.28 at s = 15 measured.
sd_time_more: Split: one U-Net pass 0.319 s at batch 1 and 0.610 s for a guided step's batch of two; VAE decode 0.488 s; text encoder 0.025 s; 25 guided steps 15.8 s for the whole pipeline against 15.75 s summed from the pieces measured (Apple M1 Pro, fp16, attention slicing).
